shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile facing right
curled/beaded stylized beard rendered in rows of drilled curls
almond eye shown frontally in a profile head
headdress/diadem band with rosette or beaded ornament
low relief carving of a single dominant figure on a rectangular slab
justification: Both show a bearded male in strict right-facing profile with the same highly conventional treatment: rows of drilled bead-like curls for beard and hair, frontal almond eye in a profile head, prominent ear with a pendant earring, and an ornamented headband, plus tasselled cords across the chest — a very specific shared scheme. The main difference is scope and attributes: A shows the whole standing winged figure with raised hand, bucket and plant-like object, while B is a bust-scale head with a tall pointed cap and no wings or held objects visible.
